main_measure.name: OLS slope of drift-removed 5-bar return on forecast, non-overlapping grid, coins pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 (and timing gain > 0); reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: timing gain: book mean daily return before costs minus gain from market's rise

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2 and the timing gain is above zero.
reading: All grid bars count as cases, including bars with forecast 0. The regression has an intercept. The drift is each coin's mean grid 5-bar return over all windows. The timing gain uses per-bar position x next-bar return, averaged over coins per UTC day, minus position x the coin's mean daily return.
